ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Manipulation Of Default Accounts Via Net.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious manipulations of default accounts such as 'administrator' and 'guest'. For example 'enable' or 'disable' accounts or change the password...etc

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\net\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\net1\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "net\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "net1\.exe")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ user\\ .*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ Järjestelmänvalvoja\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ Rendszergazda\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ Администратор\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ Administrateur\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ Administrador\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ Administratör\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ Administrator\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ guest\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ DefaultAccount\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\"Järjestelmänvalvoja\\"\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\"Rendszergazda\\"\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\"Администратор\\"\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\"Administrateur\\"\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\"Administrador\\"\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\"Administratör\\"\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\"Administrator\\"\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\"guest\\"\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\"DefaultAccount\\"\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\'Järjestelmänvalvoja\\'\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\'Rendszergazda\\'\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\'Администратор\\'\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\'Administrateur\\'\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\'Administrador\\'\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\'Administratör\\'\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\'Administrator\\'\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\'guest\\'\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\'DefaultAccount\\'\\ .*"))) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*guest.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/active\\ no.*")))
